fields.Stated goal: Grow to fifteen staff without me being the bottleneck on every job. Stop doing books at the kitchen table at night.
Tool stack: Mostly paper / nothing digital — we run on email and spreadsheets
fields.File storage: A mix of these — it depends who saved it
fields.Pain narrative: Owner doing books at night. Apprentices losing job notes. Receivables stretching to 45 days. We've started losing quote competitions to faster competitors.
fields.Biggest frustration: Manual data entry — re-typing the same info between tools
fields.Hated weekly task: Re-entering Friday's job sheets into MYOB on Sunday night.
fields.AI appetite: Open to it if you can show it works.
fields.Future state vision: I want my evenings back. I want apprentices to know what jobs they have tomorrow without asking me. I want quotes to go out the same day instead of three days later.
fields.Anything else notes: Trial run only — this is mock data for testing the report writer skill.
